subject: Queries in the implementation of iRACE for parameter tuning

messages.author: 3afafc4a6d58036f
messages.subject: Queries in the implementation of iRACE for parameter tuning
parts:
I am currently trying to use iRACE for parameter tuning of a metaheuristic implemented in C++. I have a number of questions and I request to answer to my doubts and queries.

1. I have listed the parameters in "parameters.txt". I don't know how these parameter values will be read by my program?
2. The cost was being written in an output file but I don't know how it will be sent to the target-runner file?
3. Please let me know if the following are to be kept as such in the target-runner file in our implementation as I am unable to understand its significance.
CONFIG_ID="$1"  
INSTANCE_ID="$2"
SEED="$3"  
INSTANCE=''$4

4. I am attaching the list of commands which I used to run iRACE for tuning of the parameters. I am getting an error (attached below) while running these commands to run my code. Please check.  
"

I hope my doubts and queries would be rectified.

Thank you.

messages.author: 854a0709976c2a48
messages.subject: Re: Queries in the implementation of iRACE for parameter tuning
parts:
Dear Yogita,

There is a very complete and detailed user-guide here: https://mlopez-ibanez.github.io/irace/irace-package.pdf
and it contains a step-by-step example using a C program (ACOTSP), so very close to what you are trying to do.
All your doubts and queries are answered in the guide already. Please read it in detail, it took us many hours to write it.

Cheers,

Manuel.
